recommended_wording: CoordRep enables cross-domain active-site homology search between molecular coordination complexes and extended framework nodes. In a pilot study of 500 MOF/coordination-polymer nodes and 3000 molecular reference records, the top-1 coordination-homology match was chemically reasonable in 100% of audited cases (CoordRep full retrieval: 67% correct, vs CShM-only: 10%, donor-only: 63%, random same-metal: 37%).
